records.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
records.locator: §4.2 printedp367 PDFp9; Eq21 and following negative-orientation paragraphs, extracted lines741–821; §4.3 discrete moderate-atom kernel observation lines983–993; §6.4 printedp371 PDFp13 Eq49, lines1469–1495
records.mechanism: CRPS CDF integral and expectation/kernel identity valid for probability measures with finite first moment
records.loss: Loss orientation is E|X-y| minus one-half E|X-Xprime|; it is the negative of the paper's positively oriented score
records.training: Proper-score minimization can train probabilistic models
records.application: General probabilistic forecasting, with weather examples
records.V3_difference: The finite pairwise formula and its strict propriety are known; V3 chooses U, normalization and a joint transformed-mean MSE objective.
records.limit: Strict propriety does not imply calibration, optimization convergence or RMSE improvement of a three-atom fitted model.

records.authors: Wenhui Feng; Yuan Li; Xingfa Zhang
records.title: A mixture deep neural network GARCH model for volatility forecasting
records.locator: §3.1 printedp3818 PDFp5 Eq3.2; §3.2.1 printedp3819 PDFp6 Algorithm1; §3.2.2 printedp3820 PDFp7 Eqs3.4–3.5, extracted lines197–374
records.mechanism: LSTM/DeepAR parameters of a Gaussian mixture for logarithmic conditional volatility under a GARCH model
records.loss: Average negative quasi-log-likelihood with Gaussian or Student return perturbation assumptions
records.training: BIC/cluster initialization and sampling/reparameterization described in Algorithm1
records.application: Conditional financial volatility, with CSI300 study
records.V3_difference: V3 models U as a finite law and exactly sums g_A over its atoms; it uses observed rolling-overlap A, direct supervised U and sigma7 labels, and CRPS_U plus sigma-mean MSE.
records.limit: The compared target is conditional variance/volatility in the source GARCH construction, not an asserted identity to centered sample sigma7. No source-performance values are transferred.
